research_object.title: REMoDNaV: Robust Eye Movement Detection for Natural Viewing
research_object.scope: Numerical results, figures and manuscript, including explicitly linked computational components.

S-01.rationale: Starting at this paper repository, the README states the roles of raw inputs, statistics/figure code and manuscript. Root registrations and nested REMoDNaV registrations locate all identified essential computational modules. The internal lab-eyetracking acquisition source is not consumed by the paper analysis: published raw eye-gaze files are its inputs.

assessments.comment: Inspection-only independent replicate 2 using frozen evidence cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7. Scope includes numerical results, figures and manuscript and their explicitly linked computational modules; dormant quality_stats results remain in scope. The published raw eye-gaze files are inputs; re-acquiring their upstream laboratory source is not required by the paper procedure. Cached source and historical provenance were inspected; no scientific workflow, build, data retrieval or network call was performed. Data, binary figure/style payloads and container layers were explicitly not supplied, not observed retrieval failures. Results-containerized points to a 2023 state older than the assessed 2025 root/OCI conversion, and the historical record documents a minor histogram difference from journal output. Native completion and the inspection report completion are distinct. Scores describe this provisional rubric perspective, not scientific merit or independent reproduction.
